action.objective: Complete broad search over both legal moves (e3e4, f1f3) to find the best escape from check and assess king safety.
action.rationale: In check with only two legal moves: e3e4 and f1f3. Previous game history shows f1f3 was refuted by Qxf3#, but I must not rely on that without fresh evidence. Broad search covering all legal roots is required at depth 3-4. Use 3000 nodes within the broad-search allowance to compare both candidates and their resulting king safety.
